2292-7084-8338.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

643-2638-3000-3510.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-2638-3000-3510.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2558-3490-5231-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4802-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
4802-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1170-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
392-1170-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

2104-5144-7874.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking The Immortal Weapons and exiling Ephemerate.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking The Immortal Weapons.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1671-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

1263-2438-4556-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-2946-4871-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2946-4871-6887.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

3375-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1251-1368-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1251-1368-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5708-7275-7509.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
5708-7275-7509.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Gleeful Arsonist.
Gleeful Arsonist dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Gleeful Arsonist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Gleeful Arsonist, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

647-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
647-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
647-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

3197-4120-5231-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
3197-4120-5231-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

539-560-3899-4552-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3991-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
2921-3991-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

339-677-997-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2341-2495-2585.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Grim Monolith and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Grim Monolith and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Grim Monolith and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3200-7060.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3490-4476-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4476-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-4415-4924-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2511-4215-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
2511-4215-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1594-3532-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
1594-3532-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

3940-4613-5643-6586.easyPrerequisites:
You've cast a spell this turn.
You've had a Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
3940-4613-5643-6586.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Geralf and Haze of Rage's storm ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Rogue for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells, giving creatures you control +1/+0 for each spell and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Activate the Zombie Rogue using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Repeat.

104-261-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-261-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1168-1651-4935-5542-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-4935-5542-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-4935-5542-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Delney, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

725-4929-6702.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1339-5256-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
1339-5256-6713.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1423-2131-2541.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Golgari Grave-Troll from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing you to discard Golgari Grave-Troll.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

392-2871-6259.notablePrerequisites: Your speed is at least X.
392-2871-6259.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Seething Anger.
Repeat.

1432-1636-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
1432-1636-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1322-1379-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1322-1379-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-1379-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2281-2511-2757-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2511-2757-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

369-1258-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

63-1409-3263-4659.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Wernog.
63-1409-3263-4659.description:
Activate Wernog by paying {2}, blinking it.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers once.
Resolve both Wernog triggers, creating at least two Clue artifact tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wernog.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two Clue tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Clue tokens and mana, you may sacrifice them to draw infinite cards.

1258-2366-3293-4050-4572.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding one mana of any color.
Dryad Arbor dies, triggering Abduction, returning Dryad Arbor to the battlefield.
Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning Abduction to the battlefield enchanting Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

1283-3525-4880.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Weaver of Currents.
Weaver of Currents does not have summoning sickness.
1283-3525-4880.description:
Activate Weaver of Currents by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Weaver of Currents.
Repeat.

2034-2198-2382-2557.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3}, creating two token copies of Deceiver Exarch with haste.
The Deceiver Exarch tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Mimic Vat and any other permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Deceiver Exarch tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

148-1525-3681-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton and Keen Sense attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
148-1525-3681-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
